frf.text: Anafenza, newly khan for two weeks, climbs the First Tree barefoot to receive the heads of the houses at the Amber Throne, and the last delegate is her cousin Oret.

A flashback shows how, at thirteen, she lived aboard her house's rolling fortress on the Salt Road until a Sultai ambush shattered the kin-tree, and she found Abzan soldiers slaughtering their own kin.
She and Gvar fled into the wastes, she ambushed two traitorous pursuers, and the captured attacker named Oret as the one who hired the Sultai.
In the present Anafenza coolly confronts Oret, scars his face with the Khan-Blade and disowns him before the First Tree, declaring him her enemy.

dtk.text: Anafenza is executed for worshipping her ancestors, though many in Dromoka's lands secretly keep to the old ways.
As a captain, she flees a Kolaghan horde with Oret, leads him to a kin-tree and calls on its ancestors, merging with the spirits to kill Gvar Barzeel and his entire warband.
Oret's scalelord crushes the tree and learns of her necromancy, and the dragon agrees to let Oret execute her himself, so he beheads her as she kneels, whispering that it is not the end.
Afterward Oret secretly gathers the amber shards and plants a new tree with her name carved in it so her spirit has an anchor, and he travels the Dromoka lands to tell the truth of the Guardian.
